children: Labcorp reaffirmed 2026 guidance and presented a 2026–2029 long-term outlook targeting 5%–8% revenue CAGR and 8.5%–11.5% adjusted EPS CAGR.
Reaffirms full-year 2026 guidance: enterprise revenue $14,710M–$14,827M and adjusted EPS $18.10–$18.55.
Long-term outlook (2026–2029): revenue CAGR 5%–8% and adjusted EPS CAGR 8.5%–11.5%, with 75–150 bps margin expansion.
2026 free cash flow guidance of $1,240M–$1,360M; free cash flow growth expected in line with adjusted EPS.
Strategic priorities: lead in specialty testing, partner with health systems and pharma, drive personalized health, and invest in AI/robotics.
Capital deployment plan (2027–2029): ~4% revenue capex, M&A to add 1.5%–2.5% CAGR, dividends targeted at 15%–20% of adjusted earnings.
